ai_summary: Deepak Nitrite Limited's wholly-owned subsidiary has approved an approximate ₹2,500 Crores capital investment to establish a new Bisphenol A (BPA) manufacturing plant. This strategic project aims to create a highly integrated chemical manufacturing platform, enabling vertical integration from raw materials to polycarbonate resins, fulfilling captive demand, and positioning the company to capitalize on India's rapidly growing BPA market, with funding planned through a mix of debt and equity.
